subject: Conflict involving roof structure bracing clashing with the rooftop mechanical equipment

messages.text: The roof structure bracing clashing with the rooftop mechanical equipment curb, the adjacent electrical conduit rack, and the roof drain plumbing leader at Gridline C/4 needs resolution before we can release for fabrication. This needs immediate attention; multiple trades are blocked. Please respond within two weeks so we can keep fabrication on track.

Hold fabrication release at Gridline C/4 pending a coordination sketch for the roof structure bracing clashing with the rooftop mechanical equipment curb, the adjacent electrical conduit rack, and the roof drain plumbing leader.

Revised model attached reflecting resolution of the roof structure bracing clashing with the rooftop mechanical equipment curb, the adjacent electrical conduit rack, and the roof drain plumbing leader at Gridline C/4.
